items.evidence: The locked acceptance test 'does not count time the process spends waiting' passes (304 ms). Holdout check through the public export: the value equals (user+system)/1000; readings are monotonic; a 400 ms setTimeout sleep adds 0.35 ms CPU; a 500 ms Atomics.wait adds 0.06 ms CPU; a fixed workload uses 80.0 ms CPU idle and 83.8 ms under 3x core load (wall 196 ms). All checks pass.

The locked acceptance test 'counts twice the work as about twice the time' passes (227 ms). Holdout check with a different workload (sorting): 2x work gives a CPU ratio of 2.00 and 4x work gives 4.00.

The grep over the five files prints nothing (exit 1). The 'bounds the work' block has 0 matches. With 42 busy processes (3 x 14 cores), the six files with --coverage: 6 files and 11 tests passed (evaluator 2.63M evals/s, invariants 1.52 us/action, full ring p95 405 ms).
